subject: Public Access Television
overview: The Medford City Council met to honor local community members, debate the long-standing delay and funding for public access television, and review concerns regarding police facilities and traffic calming measures.

items.title: Commendation to Henry and Evelyn Miller
items.summary: The Council presented a proclamation recognizing Henry and Evelyn Miller for their work supporting individuals with intellectual and physical disabilities.

items.title: Discussion on Medford Police Department Conditions
items.summary: Councilor Penta raised concerns regarding sewage backups, poor facility conditions, and staffing shortages at the police station; the paper was received and placed on file.

items.title: Public Access Television Funding and Delay
items.summary: The Council and several residents discussed cable ratepayer fees collected without an active public access television station, approving a motion requesting an update from the administration on Comcast channel initiatives.

items.title: Update on Citywide Resident Permit Parking
items.summary: The Council passed a motion requesting an update from the Traffic Commission regarding a proposed citywide resident parking permit program.

items.title: Speed Bumps on Harvard Street and Central Avenue
items.summary: The Council discussed the installation of speed bumps instead of raised crosswalks and passed a motion inquiring about the administration's policy, amended to request painting the Winthrop Street crosswalk yellow.

items.title: Petition for City-Side Building Maintenance Chief
items.summary: Resident Jean Martin advocated for creating a dedicated maintenance position for city-owned buildings; the petition was received and placed on file.

items.title: Condolences and Commendations
items.summary: The Council expressed condolences to the families of Rose Femineau and Joan Sacco-Sullivan, thanked Teamsters Local 25 for a toy donation, and congratulated Councilor Knight on the birth of his son.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The Council voted to table the minutes of the December 8 meeting.
